title: Gules volant in a field argent
html_source:
In heraldry, gules means red; volant is a heraldic attitude used for a bird indicating spread wings, usually flying upward; field is the background (usually of the shield); argent is silver.

EDIT: I just found out this is the Joyce family crest!
